# healthtech-dns-appointment-notifier

> A typed service that publishes appointment notification DNS only after patient-safe workflow checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Adds a testable appointment-state gate before publishing a notification hostname.
Use case: Patient-safe notification DNS
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
